baseline_models.focus_anchor: The focus sequence خ ل ق -> ن ز ل -> خ ر ج -> ث م ر -> ر ز ق moves from measured creation through delivery and emergence to an allotted edible outcome.
baseline_models.mechanism: A prepared upper-lower world channels water downward, draws a concealed yield outward, and converts that yield into a share addressed to the beneficiaries.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning make creation the design stage of the provisioning chain.
Delivery from above supplies the transfer that starts terrestrial production.
Making a thing leave concealment supplies the transition from latent growth to visible yield.
Ripened fruit supplies the completed material output.
An apportioned gift converts biological yield into a beneficiary-specific share.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists created objects and useful produce.
changed_reading.after: The ayah describes a measured transfer system whose stages turn cosmic arrangement into an allotted human share.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Repeated س خ ر, followed by ف ل ك, ج ر ي, ب ح ر, ء م ر, and ن ه ر, binds vessel, sea, motion, command, and river into one operational field.
baseline_models.mechanism: Potentially unruly water-space becomes traversable and distributive because vessels and channels are directed into sustained motion under retained command.

activation_trace.role: Directed service supplies the governing relation shared by vessel and rivers.
The water-going vessel supplies the mobile carrier within the network.
Flowing movement supplies the network's operative motion.
Expansiveness supplies the difficult open field that directed motion makes usable.
Binding direction supplies the effective rule under which the vessel moves.
A watercourse cut through land supplies the fixed distributive counterpart to the moving vessel.

changed_reading.before: Ships and rivers are two separate conveniences.
changed_reading.after: Ships and rivers form a commanded circulation network that converts wide water-space into reliable passage and distribution.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The repeated beneficiary construction لكم is paired with repeated س خ ر, while the vessel still runs by ء م ر attributed to God.
baseline_models.mechanism: Humans receive use and provision, but the agency that allocates, directs, and authorizes the serving systems is not transferred to them.

activation_trace.role: An allocated share supplies benefit without implying ownership of its source.
Making something serve a purpose supplies human usability while preserving an external director.
The branch of governing authority locates sovereignty over the route with God rather than the users.

changed_reading.before: The ayah grants humanity dominion over useful nature.
changed_reading.after: The ayah grants a use-right inside systems whose allocation and governing authority remain divine.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same descent-and-outbringing grammar governs water becoming fruit in the focus and scripture bringing people from darkness into light in the opening, so material cultivation becomes a model for revelatory transformation.

activation_trace.role: Delivered water supplies the material descent.
Drawing concealed yield outward supplies the material transformation.
Beneficial fruit supplies the productive endpoint.
Delivered scripture repeats the focus transfer but changes its medium from water to message.
Bringing people out repeats emergence while changing its object from fruit to persons.
Authorization supplies the governing condition for the human transformation.
A second human outbringing makes the emergence pattern recurrent rather than isolated.

structural_cues: 14:1 places descent before human outbringing, matching the focus order of water descent before fruit outbringing.
14:5 repeats human outbringing from darkness to light.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated descent, outbringing, and authorized transformation. I infer that the physical chain offers an analogical grammar for revelation; the live alternative is deliberate lexical recurrence without full material-spiritual mapping.

changed_reading.before: Rain produces food while revelation is a separate topic.
changed_reading.after: The rain-to-fruit process also stages how a delivered message can draw human life out of obscurity into a productive condition.

context_deltas.mechanism: Provision does not end at receipt: recognition answers the gift and opens increase, while divine independence prevents that response from becoming payment to a needy giver.

activation_trace.role: Ripened fruit supplies the completed gift that calls for reception.
An allotted gift supplies the relational input to the response loop.
Acknowledging a benefit supplies the human return movement.
The root's fresh-growth branch gives gratitude a vegetative resonance inside the focus fruit chain.
Growth and increase supply the feedback that follows recognition.
Independence removes any inference that the giver needs the beneficiary's response.

structural_cues: 14:7 explicitly orders recognition before increase.
14:8 says universal rejection would leave God independent.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a conditional recognition-to-increase sequence and immediate divine independence. I infer provision -> gratitude -> enlarged provision as a beneficiary-forming loop; alternatively, increase may be a general promise rather than a description of the focus ecology.

changed_reading.before: The fruit and transport systems deliver a one-way benefit.
changed_reading.after: Their benefit enters a noncommercial growth loop in which recognition enlarges the recipient's share without meeting any need in the giver.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus produces ripe, nourishing, allotted yield; 14:18 presents acquired work as burnt residue dispersed by force, creating a polarity between outcome that can sustain and outcome that cannot be retained.

activation_trace.role: Fruit as realized benefit supplies the retained productive outcome.
Nourishing provision supplies an outcome that can actually sustain its recipient.
Purposive deeds supply the attempted production whose result is tested.
Burnt residue supplies the anti-fruit: output stripped of nourishment and coherence.
Moving air supplies the carrier that removes rather than distributes usable yield.
A force that lifts and scatters supplies destructive circulation.
Seeking and acquiring benefit sharpens the failure to hold any benefit at the end.

structural_cues: 14:18 explicitly denies power over anything acquired after the ash is scattered.
The focus ends its first chain in fruit and nourishment rather than residue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two opposed output-and-distribution scenes. I infer a productive-yield versus dissipated-yield contrast; alternatively, the ash simile may judge deeds without inviting comparison to the focus fruit.

changed_reading.before: Fruit is merely one kind of provision.
changed_reading.after: Fruit becomes the positive pole of outcome that matures, remains available, and sustains, opposite effort reduced to ungraspable residue.

context_deltas.mechanism: The exact created-heavens-and-earth frame is tied first to the possibility of new creation and later to replacement of earth and heavens, so the focus infrastructure is ordered and real but not autonomous or permanent.

activation_trace.role: Origination supplies the focus world's dependence on a maker.
The overlying sky supplies the upper member of the current productive arrangement.
The lower earth supplies the current receiving substrate.
Repeated origination links the same cosmic frame to the possibility of another creation.
Reality matching truth prevents contingency from being mistaken for unreality.
Newness after a break supplies the first replacement horizon.
One thing standing in place of another supplies explicit cosmic replaceability.
The lower substrate itself becomes the object of replacement.
The overlying cosmic member is included in the replacement scene.

structural_cues: 14:19 repeats the focus opening about creating heavens and earth, then immediately mentions a new creation.
14:48 explicitly replaces both earth and heavens.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies exact cosmic repetition followed by two replacement horizons. I infer that the focus systems are a time-bound administered order; alternatively, eschatological replacement may qualify duration without changing how the present gifts are read.

changed_reading.before: The created hydrological and transport order is a permanent natural backdrop.
changed_reading.after: It is a truthful but contingent infrastructure, maintained for a term and replaceable by the authority that originated it.

context_deltas.mechanism: In the focus, command is visibly effective because it governs actual motion; in 14:22, promise and call produce response without coercive authority, distinguishing operative governance from persuasive speech.

activation_trace.role: Directed service supplies observable efficacy.
Actual flowing motion is the effect that verifies the direction.
Obligating direction supplies the focus route's effective cause.
The concluded affair places the contrast inside a scene where consequences have become fixed.
Speech opening expectation supplies a verbal influence that may fail.
Denied power and jurisdiction mark the missing efficacy behind the false call.
A verbal summons supplies influence that depends on the hearer's voluntary response.

structural_cues: The focus attaches vessel motion directly to divine command.
14:22 explicitly separates calling from possessing authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies effected motion under command and a responsive call without authority. I infer a contrast between efficacious ordering and bare solicitation; alternatively, the social scene may clarify responsibility without commenting on natural motion.

changed_reading.before: By His command is a conventional attribution of control.
changed_reading.after: The phrase marks command whose efficacy appears as real, sustained motion, unlike speech that recruits response while lacking governing power.

context_deltas.mechanism: The good-word tree roots below, branches into the sky, and repeatedly gives edible yield by permission; this converts the focus sky-earth-fruit system into a model of durable communicative productivity.

activation_trace.role: The overlying sky supplies the upper domain of the focus growth system.
Fertile earth supplies the lower receptive domain.
Fruit as realized benefit supplies the focus endpoint that the parable reuses.
Edible sustenance makes productive yield beneficiary-facing.
A trunked tree supplies the organism joining below, above, and yield.
A foundational base supplies durable attachment below.
Continuance and stability supply resistance to dissipation.
An elevated extension from a base supplies upward reach.
The sky becomes the tree's upper field, directly rejoining the focus cosmic frame.
Tree yield supplies a recurring edible result.
Permission supplies the condition under which the recurring yield appears.

structural_cues: 14:24 explicitly spans fixed base, elevated branch, and sky.
14:25 makes the tree's yield recurrent and permission-governed.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit word-tree comparison whose architecture overlaps the focus sky-earth-fruit chain. I infer that material productivity becomes a template for productive speech; alternatively, the focus may remain only the physical background that makes the later comparison intelligible.

changed_reading.before: The focus fruit is physical food generated by rain.
changed_reading.after: Its growth architecture also models a grounded word that repeatedly yields sustaining effects under authorization.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding instruction sends received provision back outward through expenditure, so the focus لكم does not terminate the flow at the beneficiary.

activation_trace.role: An allotted gift supplies the resource received in the focus.
Continuing provision gives the focus motion an economic as well as hydrological resonance.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies the required outward leg of provision.
The same allotted-gift branch identifies what is to be recirculated.

structural_cues: 14:31 immediately precedes the focus and commands expenditure from what was provided.
The focus repeats لكم while depicting water and vessels in motion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies provision followed by outward expenditure and then multiple physical flows. I infer receipt -> recirculation rather than receipt -> possession; alternatively, the adjacency may coordinate duties and signs without making the water system an economic analogy.

changed_reading.before: Provision for you ends in beneficiary possession and use.
changed_reading.after: Provision reaches the beneficiary as a node in circulation, with expenditure completing socially what rivers and vessels enact materially.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated subjection crosses from ship and rivers into sun, moon, night, and day; the ن ه ر root moves from watercourse to daylight, extending governed flow from spatial channels into ceaseless temporal passage.

activation_trace.role: Directed service supplies the relation carried into the next ayah.
A regular course supplies a bridge from physical motion to recurring order.
A cut channel carrying water supplies spatial flow.
Opening and widening until flow supplies the root-level transition to an opened day.
The same directed service now governs celestial and temporal pairs.
Unremitting effort supplies the continuity of the expanded service regime.
Daylight's opening turns the focus river root into a temporal aperture.

structural_cues: 14:32 and 14:33 repeat the same subjection-and-beneficiary construction.
The adjacent ayat place river and day on the same ن ه ر root while shifting domain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated subjection, ceaselessness, and a river/day root bridge. I infer one administered flow regime spanning transport, hydrology, astronomy, and time; alternatively, the river/day proximity may be wordplay without a unified mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The focus describes useful movement through water.
changed_reading.after: Its spatial circulation opens into a ceaseless order in which water channels and temporal cycles are parallel forms of directed passage.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah gathers the focus systems into given benefit that exceeds enumeration, then contrasts that excess with the beneficiary's capacity to cover the gift.

activation_trace.role: An allotted gift supplies one countable-looking unit within a larger excess.
Repeated service multiplies the forms of benefit under review.
Giving supplies the summary relation that gathers the preceding systems.
Counting supplies the attempted audit of the benefits.
Flourishing benefit names the category into which the focus systems are gathered.
Exhaustive enumeration supplies the failed measure of the total.
Covering a benefit supplies the ethical reversal of receiving it.

structural_cues: 14:34 directly follows the focus and the continuation of subjected systems in 14:33.
The focus repeatedly marks the beneficiaries, while 14:34 turns to the human response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies direct adjacency, a gift summary, failed enumeration, and concealment of benefit. I infer that the catalogue is evidentiary and ethically exposing; alternatively, 14:34 may summarize the gifts without assigning a separate ethical role to each mechanism.

changed_reading.after: Each convenience is one entry in an unfinishable account whose abundance exposes the mismatch between sustained service and human concealment of benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later prayer places descendants in a watercourse valley lacking cultivation, draws people toward them, and requests fruit provision so gratitude can arise; the focus ecology thus becomes infrastructure for settlement, worship, social attraction, and continuity.

activation_trace.role: Ripened fruit supplies the concrete requested support.
An allotted gift supplies the bridge from ecology to community maintenance.
A flood-course valley supplies a hydrological form whose actual cultivation is absent.
Cultivation and growth supply precisely the capacity negated in the settlement.
Inclination supplies a social inflow of hearts and people toward the settlement.
Requested allocation repeats the focus category as a condition of communal survival.
The same ripe fruit makes the focus chain answer a place without its own crops.
Recognition of benefit supplies the intended human outcome of the material support.

structural_cues: 14:37 locates descendants near the sacred house and explicitly states the purpose of establishing prayer.
The same ayah moves from absent cultivation through social inclination and fruit provision to gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a crop-less settlement, prayer purpose, incoming social attachment, requested fruit, and gratitude. I infer that the focus systems underwrite a civic-ritual ecology; alternatively, the prayer may invoke exceptional delivery rather than redescribe the general focus order.

changed_reading.before: Fruit provision meets individual bodily need.
changed_reading.after: It can sustain a vulnerable settlement, attract social relations, enable intergenerational worship, and culminate in communal gratitude.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the non-dominant و س م mapping supplied for س م و rather than the ordinary sky branch. It remains anchored in both focus sky occurrences and the explicit water-earth-fruit chain. Downstream prose should present it as a packet-licensed lexical activation, not as an etymological replacement for sky.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The two س م و occurrences frame water coming from above, while the split inventory includes first rain making earth visibly marked by vegetation.

activation_trace.role: First rain leaving a vegetal mark supplies an inscription-like effect for the sky-water relation.
Conveying water supplies the medium that makes the mark.
Fertile ground supplies the receiving surface.
Emergence from concealment makes the mark visible as growth.

changed_reading.before: The sky is only the source region from which water descends.
changed_reading.after: Sky-water can be heard as writing its identifying mark on earth by making hidden vegetation appear.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because a social labor branch is activated inside a statement about vessel and rivers. It remains directly anchored in repeated س خ ر and repeated لكم, with authority retained in ء م ر. Downstream prose should treat it as an ethical analogy about beneficiary asymmetry, not as a claim that natural entities literally hold labor contracts.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated س خ ر places two systems in service for human beneficiaries, and its inventory includes compelled work without wages.

activation_trace.role: Work extracted without wages supplies the provocative labor image for natural service.
Allocated benefit identifies humans as recipients of the service rather than its source.
Governing authority limits the analogy by locating command beyond the beneficiaries.

changed_reading.before: Natural systems are convenient tools available to humans.
changed_reading.after: Their service can expose an asymmetry in which humans receive the yield of labor they neither originate nor ultimately command.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries an affective branch of ب ح ر into a physical sea crossing. It remains anchored in the vessel-running-in-the-sea construction and the explicit command relation. Downstream prose should qualify it as a secondary spatial-affective analogy, not identify every sea with psychological confusion.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The vessel runs through ب ح ر under direction, while the sea root inventory includes bewilderment alongside width and water.

activation_trace.role: Bewilderment supplies the affective version of an open field without obvious bearings.
The vessel supplies a bounded carrier through the disorienting field.
Directed service supplies orientation and usable passage.
Binding direction supplies the route through otherwise unbounded uncertainty.

changed_reading.before: The ship crosses a physically wide sea.
changed_reading.after: Its commanded course can also figure orientation through a field that would otherwise produce bewilderment.

strongest_changes: The opening repetition of ن ز ل and خ ر ج makes the rain-to-fruit chain a material analogue for revelatory outbringing.
14:31 and 14:37 turn provision from terminal possession into circulation that sustains expenditure, settlement, worship, and gratitude.
The good-word tree converts the focus sky-earth-fruit architecture into recurring communicative yield.
The river/day bridge and repeated س خ ر extend water movement into ceaseless temporal order.
New creation and cosmic replacement bracket the useful infrastructure as real but contingent.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a hinge where vertical descent, organic emergence, horizontal passage, command, and repeated beneficiary address meet; whole-surah roots translate that one physical system into revelation, ethical circulation, temporal regularity, settlement, and accountability without erasing the material reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The repeated descent-and-outbringing sequence may be an analogical mechanism or a strong lexical echo without full cross-domain transfer.
The tree, ash, and fruit models may be separate contrasts rather than parts of one productivity system.
Non-dominant and socially distant branches such as sky-as-mark and subjection-as-unpaid-labor require explicit exploratory qualification.
